died.name: Basil I
died.cause: The Byzantine emperor's belt was entangled between antlers of a deer during a hunt and the animal subsequently dragged him for 16 mi through the woods. Because of this accident, Basil contracted fever and he died shortly afterwards.

died.name: Nick Piantanida
died.cause: making emergency transmission from Strato Jump III balloon during decompression accident on 1 May 1966; the accident left him in a coma until his death The 34-year-old skydiver died four months after an attempt to break the record for the highest parachute jump near Joe Foss Field, Sioux Falls, South Dakota; his suit had depressurized, causing brain damage from lack of oxygen.

born.name: Alan Stacey
born.cause: The 26-year-old British racing driver died in a crash during the 1960 Belgian Grand Prix when a bird struck him in the face. Twenty-two-year-old British driver Chris Bristow was killed during the same race, five laps before Stacey and on the same extended fast right-hand bend.
